mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PM_PROJECT ( PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, PROJECT_STATUS, START_DATE, END_DATE, OWNER_USERNAME, ACTIVE_YN, VERSION_NO, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{project.id}, #{project.name}, #{project.description}, #{project.status}, #{project.startDate}, #{project.endDate}, #{project.ownerUsername}, 'Y''N', 1, #{project.ownerUsername}, #{project.ownerUsername} )
mapper.update: UPDATE PM_PROJECT SET PROJECT_NAME = #{project.name}, DESCRIPTION = #{project.description}, PROJECT_STATUS = #{project.status}, START_DATE = #{project.startDate}, END_DATE = #{project.endDate}, OWNER_USERNAME = #{project.ownerUsername}, ACTIVE_YN = 'Y''N', VERSION_NO = VERSION_NO + 1, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{project.ownerUsername} WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{project.id} AND VERSION_NO = #{project.version}
mapper.select: SELECT PROJECT_ID, USERNAME, PROJECT_ROLE, CASE ACTIVE_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ACTIVE_FLAG FROM PM_PROJECT_MEMBER WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ORDER BY USERNAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PM_PROJECT_MEMBER ( PROJECT_ID, USERNAME, PROJECT_ROLE, ACTIVE_YN, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{member.projectId}, #{member.username}, #{member.role}, 'Y''N', #{member.username}, #{member.username} )
mapper.select: SELECT PROJECT_ID, SEQUENCE_NO, FROM_STATUS, TO_STATUS, CHANGED_BY, CHANGE_REASON, CHANGED_AT FROM PM_PROJECT_STATUS_HISTORY WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ORDER BY SEQUENCE_NO DESC
